items.label: Car Cargo Length Limit
items.val: Must not extend beyond front or rear bumpers by more than 30 cm (or max total length 12 meters).

items.label: Car Cargo Width Limit
items.val: Must not extend beyond vehicle body width (max width 2.5 meters).

items.label: Car Cargo Height Limit
items.val: Small passenger cars max 2.5 meters from ground; trucks max 3.8 meters.

items.label: Child Safety Seat Law
items.val: Children under 4 years old (or under 18 kg) MUST use an approved rear-facing/child safety seat in the REAR seat.

items.label: Front Passenger Seat Age Limit
items.val: Children under 12 years old are PROHIBITED from sitting in the front passenger seat.

items.label: Urban / Unmarked Roads
items.val: Max 50 km/h.

items.label: Slow Lane / Narrow Lanes
items.val: Max 40 km/h.

items.label: Freeway / Expressway Max Speed
items.val: 100 - 110 km/h (National Freeway 1 & 3 standard).

items.label: Freeway Min Speed (Inner Lane)
items.val: Must maintain highest speed limit (usually 90 - 110 km/h depending on segment).

items.label: Following Distance (Dry Road)
items.val: Speed (km/h) ÷ 2 in meters (e.g. 100 km/h = 50 meters distance).

items.label: Following Distance (Wet / Rain)
items.val: Double the standard following distance.

items.label: Approaching Railroad Level Crossing
items.val: Max 15 km/h, stop at least 3 to 6 meters before crossing when signal flashes.

items.label: Shoulder Driving Prohibition
items.val: Driving on hard shoulder is PROHIBITED unless signs open shoulder or in breakdown emergencies.

items.label: Breakdown Warning Sign Distance
items.val: Place warning triangle 100 meters behind vehicle on freeway (30-100m on ordinary roads).

items.label: Lane Change Signal Requirement
items.val: Signal at least 100 meters before changing lanes on expressways.

items.label: Seatbelt Enforcement
items.val: ALL occupants (front and rear) MUST wear seatbelts at all times.

items.label: Legal Breath Alcohol (BAC) Limit
items.val: 0.15 mg/L (or 0.03% blood alcohol).

items.label: Car Drunk Driving Fine (First Offense)
items.val: Fine NT$30,000–120,000, 1–2 year license suspension, vehicle impounded.

items.label: 2nd Offense within 10 years
items.val: Fine NT$120,000, license revoked for 3 years, mandatory safety course.

items.label: Refusing Sobriety Test
items.val: Fine NT$180,000, immediate license revocation, vehicle impounded.

items.label: Drunk Driving Passenger Penalty
items.val: Passengers over 18 in drunk driver's car fined NT$6,000–15,000.

items.label: Min Tire Tread Depth (Car)
items.val: At least 1.6 mm across tread grooves (inspected during periodic inspection).

items.label: Handheld Phone Fine (Car)
items.val: Fine NT$3,000 when driving a car.

items.label: Running Red Light (Car)
items.val: Fine NT$2,700–5,400 + 3 demerit points.

items.label: Opening Car Door Accident Fine
items.val: Fine NT$2,400–4,800 if opening door without checking rear causing accident.

items.label: 12 Demerit Points in 1 Year
items.val: 2-month driver license suspension.

items.label: CPR Compression-to-Ventilation Ratio
items.val: 30 compressions : 2 breaths.

items.label: CPR Compression Depth & Rate
items.val: At least 5 to 6 cm depth, 100-120 compressions per minute.

items.label: Brain Oxygen Deprivation Window
items.val: Irreversible brain damage starts after 4-6 minutes.

items.label: AED Shock Protocol
items.val: Ensure nobody is touching the patient before pressing SHOCK button.
